subject: Renewal + Scale: Dedicated pool 8→16 GPUs (term & monthly commit)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: jill.torres@acme-corp.com, sam.cho@acme-corp.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + Scale: Dedicated pool 8→16 GPUs (term & monthly commit)

Hi Jill / Sam —

As your renewal window approaches (term ends 2026-12-20), I wanted to outline a proposal to both renew and scale your Dedicated pool from 8 → 16 GPUs. Key points up front:

- Capacity: move from an 8-GPU reserved pool to a 16-GPU reserved pool (same instance family).
- Monthly commit: updated to a single monthly reserved commit; proposed commit = $82,000 / month (list pricing before any renewal concession).
- Throughput & SLOs: target steady-state throughput aligned with your current footprint; we will include a throughput SLO for inference p95 latency and provide burst capacity for traffic spikes.
- Term options: 12-month preferred; we can do 24-month for deeper commit discounts.

I've attached an updated proposal (Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_16GPU_v2.pdf) with pricing, deployment timeline, and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP). On our side, we can commit to a 7-business-day timeline for private VPC prep once the PO is in place.

Could we schedule a 30-min call this week to walk through the numbers and the timeline? Proposed windows: Thu 11/12 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 11/13 13:00–14:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this lined up for you.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_16GPU_v2.pdf (8 pages, PDF)]
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: jill.torres@acme-corp.com, legal@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Scale: Dedicated pool 8→16 GPUs (term & monthly commit)

Sean —

Thanks for the note and the proposal. A few quick items from our side before we lock a call:

1) Can you confirm the monthly commit math? We need the committed $/month broken down vs. baseline usage and what happens if we exceed the commit (overage pricing).
2) SLA/throughput: we need a clarified throughput guarantee and remediation steps if we hit sustained throttling during peak ETL/ingest windows.
3) Billing / proration: renewal date is 12/20 — how will proration work if we sign before that date?
4) Do you have a ramp plan? We won't need full 16 GPUs day one.

If you can push a short matrix answering 1–4 ahead of a call that would be helpful.

—Sam
Sam Cho
ML Platform Lead, Acme Corporation
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + Scale: Dedicated pool 8→16 GPUs (term & monthly commit)

Internal notes / suggested approach before the call with Acme: 

- Pricing: propose to present the $82k/month as list, then offer a 10–12% renewal concession if they commit to 12 months; 18% if 24 months. For this deal I recommend 12% (sounds reasonable given ARR).
- Overages: standard model: overage at metered per-GPU-hour rate; include a 5% buffer for bursts at no charge (one-time monthly).
- SLA: provide a throughput SLO: p95 latency target and a scheduled maintenance window; include escalation to our Dedicated ops team and 1-hour response for critical incidents. Put throughput numbers in the proposal appendix.
- Ramp: offer a 3-month ramp: month 1 = 10 GPUs committed (pro-rated pricing), month 2 = 14 GPUs, month 3+ = 16 GPUs. This helps Acme move smoothly and is easier for procurement to approve.

Attachments: updated MAP spreadsheet with ramp (Renewal_MA_Planned_Commit.xlsx).

If Sean is OK, I'll draft the email to send post-call with the concession and ramp spelled out.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@acme-corp.com>, jill.torres@acme-corp.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, contracts@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Scale: Dedicated pool 8→16 GPUs (term & monthly commit)

Sam / Jill —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marissa's internal suggestion and to address your items 1–4, here is a concise matrix:

- Monthly commit & pricing: Proposed list = $82,000/month for a 16-GPU reserved pool. Renewal concession: 12% off list for a 12-month renewal (final = $72,160/mo).
- Overage / bursts: Overage billed at $1.10 per GPU-hour above commit. We provide a monthly burst buffer equivalent to ~5% of committed capacity for free to cover short spikes.
- SLA / Throughput guarantee: We will include a throughput SLO in the order form: p95 inference latency under targeted workload, and a guaranteed min throughput capacity for sustained 15-minute windows. Remedy: credit up to 10% of monthly invoice if SLOs are missed per the dedicated SLA.
- Proration: If signed prior to 12/20, we will pro-rate the first month to align to the customer renewal cycle (no double-billing).
- Ramp plan: 3-month ramp (M1=10, M2=14, M3=16 GPUs). Billing aligns to committed GPUs each month.

Next steps: if this captures what you need, I'll send an updated order form and a DocuSign link for signature. Per Acme's procurement requirements, please CC contracts@acme-corp.com on the DocuSign envelope.

I've attached the updated proposal & MAP that includes the ramp and SLO appendix.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_16GPU_v2.pdf (updated with ramp & SLO appendix)]
